revision1-bed-small.limits: Controlled actual generated Game household review. Real player inputs/collision, low furniture, roof entry/exit signals and actual streamed baseline reload. Initial outside placement only; no route teleport or physics/roof-counter overrides. God mode, disabled ambient spawner/encounter beats, fixed real-camera zoom and streaming frozen after reload. Optional two real controlled ordinary/elite enemies for a short occupied route. Not continuous human play, balance/performance approval or complete-street acceptance.
revision1-bed-small.segment_binding: Validated capture tool rejects non-S2; explicit --segment argument or its documented default2. Global.attempt_segment is not separately exported by this tool.
revision1-bed-small.qualification: Recorded zero-path goal errors are about23px; valid collision contact distances are separately about41px. Original capture-info is unchanged.

bed-small.prior_evidence_qualification: The first seven-plate bed architecture run at handoff-linux-next-20261020/domestic-bed-first-plates used the inherited same-cell route behavior: post-contact goals in the current cell could return23-41px off center. Its actual positions and contacts remain recorded. Revision2 physically centers resolved goals within8px or reports blocked movement.
